title: A machine learning framework for the evaluation of myocardial rotation in patients with noncompaction cardiomyopathy.
summary: Random forest/MLP analysis of 49 rigorously diagnosed noncompaction cardiomyopathy cases links echocardiographic predictors to rigid-body rotation patterns and associated dysfunction.
ai_technology: prospective echocardiographic data, n=49 after image-quality exclusion; five-fold validation; model identifies echo predictors of RBR. Small single-center exploratory sample; authors say further prospective work is needed.
